system: One-electron spinless nonrelativistic clamped point-Coulomb H/He, electron mass m_e
x: R/a_A in asymptotic expressions; Cartesian x in differential operators
origin: nuclear charge center O unless explicit B
states: exact lowest m=0 and lowest real-cos(phi) |m|=1, positive meridional phase
domains: D(H_R)=H^2; distribution identities H^-2; Lg in L^2 sufficient, not assumed in D(H_R)
norms: Sobolev estimates nondimensionalized by fixed a_A,E_A
trajectory: smooth prescribed paths with R>0; no R=0 passage
ETF: B-centered or O-centered common spatial ETF explicitly labeled; not scalar-rephasing-equivalent in general
tail: R>=c(1+|t|), bounded velocity, nuclear accelerations O(t^-2)
atomic_to_exact: small-R H^-2 resolvent bounds; large-R H1 quasimode/Hardy bounds
